application_basis: D.lgs. 19/2021 effective 2021-03-13; held Article 27 text governs the admitted event horizon

application_basis: D.lgs. 19/2021 effective 2021-03-13; held Article 28 text governs the admitted event horizon

application_basis: D.lgs. 19/2021 effective 2021-03-13; held Article 28 text governs the admitted event horizon
true_effect: Immediately adopt precautionary measures aimed at preventing pest establishment and spread.
false_effect: Without the source-defined operator knowledge, this precautionary duty does not activate. Missing knowledge evidence remains UNKNOWN.

application_basis: D.lgs. 19/2021 effective 2021-03-13; held Article 28 text governs the admitted event horizon
true_effect: Decide the official confirmation of the finding on the diagnosis of a validly designated official laboratory; the confirmed finding (OFFICIAL_FINDING_CONFIRMED — pest, medium, place, date carried by the finding act) is the event on which every post-confirmation duty starts.
false_effect: Without regional suspicion or detection the confirmation duty is not activated; after activation and before the decision the confirmation is pending — the trigger is not false and the pending state confirms nothing.
evidence_contract: Report, Article 27 survey or official-control trigger evidence; exact pest and territory; official sample and custody; diagnosis from a validly designated official laboratory for the task; regional official-confirmation decision.
semantic_note: The duty activates from regional suspicion or detection; the laboratory diagnosis is the basis of the decision, not the decision; the decision is the completed legal result (OFFICIAL_FINDING_CONFIRMED) that Articles 29–31, the Union Article 4 duty and the regional area rows consume. Duty activation, authority exercise and completed legal result are three events (refresh 2026-09-02).

application_basis: D.lgs. 19/2021 effective 2021-03-13; held Article 28 text governs the admitted event horizon
true_effect: Immediately adopt suitable interim plant-health measures to prevent any risk of spread while official confirmation is pending.
false_effect: If suspicion is absent or official confirmation is complete, this pending-confirmation precaution route does not apply. Missing confirmation-status evidence remains UNKNOWN.
evidence_contract: Regional suspicion state; exact pest and territory; unresolved official-confirmation state; selected interim measures, legal basis, timing and completion evidence.
semantic_note: Interim precaution does not convert suspicion into an official confirmed finding.

application_basis: D.lgs. 19/2021 effective 2021-03-13; held Article 28 text governs the admitted event horizon
actor_role: Private or public subject receiving competent regional instructions
true_effect: Adopt the instructed necessary plant-health measures, including elimination of affected plants, plant products or other objects where lawfully required.
false_effect: Without competent regional instructions applicable to the subject, this instruction-specific duty does not activate. Missing instruction or service evidence remains UNKNOWN.
evidence_contract: Competent regional instruction and legal basis; exact subject, sites and affected plants, products or objects; effective communication; implementation and completion evidence.
semantic_note: The Regional Plant Health Service owns the instruction. The subject owns compliance; the instruction cannot exceed the applicable substantive legal population.

application_basis: D.lgs. 19/2021 effective 2021-03-13; held Article 29 text governs the admitted event horizon
true_effect: Enter the presence or applicable suspicion information and first adopted plant-health measures in the Union electronic notification system.
false_effect: Without receipt of official confirmation, this notification-entry duty does not activate. Missing confirmation-receipt or entry evidence remains UNKNOWN.
evidence_contract: Official-confirmation decision and regional receipt time; pest presence or applicable suspicion; first adopted measures; Union-system entry and timestamp.
semantic_note: Regional entry is not the Central Plant Health Service’s official Commission notification.

application_basis: D.lgs. 19/2021 effective 2021-03-13; held Article 29 text governs the admitted event horizon
true_effect: Officially notify the European Commission through the Union electronic system of the finding and first applied measures.
false_effect: Without the completed regional entry and a source-listed category, this central official-notification duty does not activate. Missing category or notification evidence remains UNKNOWN.
evidence_contract: Completed Article 29(1) entry and timestamp; exact source-listed category; finding and first applied measures; central official Commission notification and timestamp.
semantic_note: The three-working-day clock is sequential. It is not anchored directly to the laboratory result.

application_basis: D.lgs. 19/2021 effective 2021-03-13; held Article 30 text governs the admitted event horizon
true_effect: Inform the potentially affected professional operators of the confirmed Union quarantine-pest presence without delay.

semantic_note: Affected-operator information is distinct from individual or mass service of a restrictive measure.

application_basis: D.lgs. 19/2021 effective 2021-03-13; held Article 30 text governs the admitted event horizon
true_effect: Define the methods for informing the public about adopted and intended measures and measures required from relevant professional-operator or other-person categories.

evidence_contract: Official-confirmation decision; priority-pest status; committee public-information method decision; public content, channel and publication evidence.
semantic_note: Public information is distinct from the legal service or effectiveness of an individual or mass restrictive measure.

true_effect: Investigate without delay the origin of the confirmed presence and whether plant, plant-product or object movements may have spread the pest.

evidence_contract: Official-confirmation decision; exact pest and finding; plant, product and object supply, movement, origin, destination and spread evidence; investigation findings.
semantic_note: Investigation informs spread and area decisions. It does not itself create area geography.

application_basis: D.lgs. 19/2021 effective 2021-03-13; held Article 31 text governs the admitted event horizon
true_effect: Immediately adopt the urgent and necessary plant-health measures that lawfully eliminate spread risk from the affected area.
false_effect: Without official confirmation or a necessary urgent response, this route does not activate. Missing necessity or measure evidence remains UNKNOWN.
evidence_contract: Official-confirmation decision; affected area and spread risk; urgency and necessity assessment; selected measure, legal basis, timing and completion evidence.

application_basis: D.lgs. 19/2021 Article 31(3) under directly applicable Regulation 2020/1201 Articles 7–12
true_effect: Apply eradication only when the resolved shared branch result is ERADICATION_CONTROLS.

true_effect: Preserve the outstanding directly applicable Article 4 duty and require the Regional Plant Health Service to proceed through the separate national opinion and constitutive-act route.

evidence_contract: Official plant finding; effective Union area provisions; committee opinion where required; exact regional constitutive area act, geometry and effective time.
semantic_note: The Union duty is independent of Italian procedural compliance. Article 6(3)(g) and the later constitutive act separately determine national authority/validity and operative geography.

application_basis: D.lgs. 19/2021 effective 2021-03-13; held Article 31 text governs the admitted event horizon
true_effect: Using available data and information, define and approve the plant-health measures in conformity with the applicable emergency plan.

true_effect: Decide whether to approve the proposed regional eradication-or-containment action plan.

application_basis: D.lgs. 19/2021 effective 2021-03-13; held Article 31 text governs the admitted event horizon
true_effect: Officially adopt the committee-approved action plan.

semantic_note: Committee approval and central emergency declaration are separate legal events.

true_effect: Notify the officially adopted action plan to the European Commission.

true_effect: Activate the Phytosanitary Emergency Secretariat for coordination of action-plan measure implementation.

true_effect: Establish the territorial emergency unit for implementation of the adopted action plan in the regional territory.

application_basis: D.lgs. 19/2021 effective 2021-03-13; held Article 31 text governs the admitted event horizon
true_effect: Implement the action-plan plant-health measures through the lawful competences of the participating actors.

evidence_contract: Established territorial unit; adopted action plan and exact measures; participant competences and assignments; as-run implementation and completion evidence.
semantic_note: The unit implements within participant competences. It does not become a new source of substantive duties or reserved decisions.

application_basis: D.lgs. 19/2021 effective 2021-03-13 under effective EU area law
true_effect: Modify the demarcated area through a competent constitutive act under the effective area rules.

evidence_contract: Current area version; periodic survey results; effective EU area rule; modification-necessity decision; exact successor constitutive area act and effective time.

application_basis: D.lgs. 19/2021 effective 2021-03-13; held Article 31 text governs the admitted event horizon
true_effect: Conduct periodic surveys in the demarcated area to determine evolution of pest presence.
false_effect: Without a legally operative demarcated area, this area-specific survey duty does not activate. Missing area or survey evidence remains UNKNOWN.
evidence_contract: Exact demarcated-area version and interval; applicable survey design; as-run inspections, samples, tests and results; pest-evolution findings.

true_effect: Communicate all area-survey and area-modification information to the Central Plant Health Service.

semantic_note: Reporting communicates the area state and evidence. It does not create or modify that state.

application_basis: D.lgs. 19/2021 effective 2021-03-13; held Article 32 text governs the admitted event horizon
true_effect: Ensure territorial implementation of every applicable official measure necessary for plant protection.

semantic_note: Implementation responsibility does not itself select the substantive measure or plant population. Terminal framework citations for this proposition: EU-2016-2031:Annex-II. The retained national text fully states the in-scope actor, trigger and effect; no separate Stage A branch is imported.

application_basis: D.lgs. 19/2021 effective 2021-03-13; held Article 32 text governs the admitted event horizon
true_effect: Place the plant, plant product or other object within the statutory population on which applicable Article 32(1) official measures are implemented.

evidence_contract: Exact plant, plant product or object; pest; confirmed or suspected introduction/spread risk and source; applicable Article 32(1) measure.
semantic_note: This is a statutory subject-population rule. It does not select a concrete measure or prove risk from missing data.

application_basis: D.lgs. 19/2021 effective 2021-03-13; held Article 32 text governs the admitted event horizon
true_effect: Determine the costs of the activities necessary to obtain complete and correct implementation.

evidence_contract: Lawful substitute-execution decision; exact activities necessary for complete and correct implementation; as-run work, quantity and cost evidence; competent cost determination.
semantic_note: The cost determination is downstream of lawful substitute execution. It does not prove the primary failure.

actor_role: Owner or holder of the land
true_effect: Implement the prescribed measure and bear its economic cost.
false_effect: If no valid applicable measure imposes primary implementation on the owner or holder, this duty does not activate. Missing implementation evidence after activation remains UNKNOWN.
evidence_contract: Valid measure and legal basis; exact owner or holder and land; effective prescription; required terms, methods and time; primary implementation and cost evidence.
semantic_note: Completion evidence does not activate the primary duty. Missing execution evidence does not prove breach.

application_basis: D.lgs. 19/2021 effective 2021-03-13; held Article 32 text governs the admitted event horizon
true_effect: Exercise the statutory right of recourse for determined substitute-execution costs against the person legally obligated in the primary instance.

evidence_contract: Lawful substitute execution; competent cost determination; exact primary obligor; recourse decision, amount, notice and recovery record.
semantic_note: The source grants a right of recourse. It does not require exercise of that right in every case.

application_basis: D.lgs. 19/2021 effective 2021-03-13; held Article 32 text governs the admitted event horizon
true_effect: Implement the measure in substitution to obtain complete and correct execution.
false_effect: Complete conforming primary implementation defeats substitute execution. Missing execution evidence remains UNKNOWN and does not establish default.
evidence_contract: Valid primary prescription; exact obligated person and required performance; execution evidence proving total or partial omission, incompleteness or deviation; competent substitute-execution decision; as-run completion evidence.
semantic_note: Substitute execution is distinct from direct public execution and later coercive enforcement under Article 55.

application_basis: D.lgs. 19/2021 effective 2021-03-13 under applicable Union law and exact emergency-measure limits
true_effect: Implement the official emergency plant-health measure notwithstanding conflicting constraints only within the measure’s exact limits and criteria and subject to Union law.
false_effect: Without a valid applicable emergency measure, no general derogation arises. Missing scope or criteria evidence remains UNKNOWN.
reserved_decision_owner: Competent plant-health authority identified by the measure
evidence_contract: Valid emergency measure or ordinance; exact actor, population, limits and criteria; applicable Union obligations; assigned implementation and completion evidence.

application_basis: D.lgs. 19/2021 effective 2021-03-13 under D.lgs. 42/2004 Article 146 and applicable Union law
true_effect: Decide case by case whether to remove the uninfected monumental or historic-interest plant after landscape authorization and consistently with Union obligations.

evidence_contract: Valid removal measure and exact demarcated-area state; plant identity and monumental or historic legal status; evidence that infection is not currently established; landscape-authorization application, opinion and decision; applicable Union obligations; case-specific removal decision.
semantic_note: This route is distinct from removal of a confirmed infected plant, EU Article 7(3) retention and general emergency derogation. Apparent monumentality does not establish protected legal status.

application_basis: D.lgs. 19/2021 effective 2021-03-13 under the completed source-defined publicity route
actor_role: Authorized plant-health inspector, agent or support personnel
true_effect: Access the land within the person’s official authority to implement the applicable plant-health measures.
false_effect: If legally effective publicity, authorization or the infected-plant land predicate is absent, this access route is unavailable. Missing evidence remains UNKNOWN.
evidence_contract: Exact measure and publicity route; completed legally effective publicity; territorial authorization and official role; land and infected-plant evidence; access purpose and as-run access record.
semantic_note: Authority over the communication method is not completion evidence. Access requires the completed legally effective route and territorial authorization.

application_basis: D.lgs. 19/2021 effective 2021-03-13 under Law 241/1990 Article 21-bis
actor_role: Competent central or territorial regional plant-health service
true_effect: Allocates authority to establish the methods and terms used to communicate that plant-health measure or ordinance.
